# SwitchClaude — llms.txt

> SwitchClaude is a menubar app that switches between multiple Claude Desktop
> accounts in ~2 seconds. One-time payment, no subscription.

## What it is
- Menubar (tray) switcher for Claude Desktop on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
- Supports accounts with email login and Google login.
- Each account lives in an isolated profile: chats, projects, and sessions never mix and are never deleted by switching.
- Switching restarts Claude Desktop with the selected profile (~2 seconds).

## Pricing (one-time, USD, no subscription)
- Starter: $0 — 1 account, 7-day trial.
- Pro: $9.99 one-time per extra account (e.g. 2 extra = $19.98).
- Team: $29 one-time — up to 5 accounts.

## Licensing
- After Stripe Checkout, the buyer receives a key like `CLAUDE-SWITCHER-XXXX-XXXX`.
- The key is pasted in the app under Settings → License and verified at `POST /api/validate`.
- Keys are bound to devices (1 + number of extra accounts) and cached for 7 days of offline use.
- Contact for license resets: info@lv8.gr.

## Platform facts
- Requires the official Claude Desktop app by Anthropic (separate download).
- SwitchClaude is not affiliated with Anthropic.
- Download: https://switchclaude.com/#download
- Privacy: https://switchclaude.com/privacy

## FAQ (short answers)
- How fast is switching? About 2 seconds: quit Claude, relaunch with the other profile.
- Are my chats safe? Yes — profiles are isolated directories; switching never deletes data.
- Does it work with Google login? Yes — log in once per profile, it stays saved.
- Which platforms? macOS 12+, Windows 10+, Ubuntu 20+ (and most Linux distros).
- Is there a subscription? No. Pay once per extra account, lifetime updates.
